name: alert-dialog
title: Alert dialog
description: Asks people to confirm or cancel one consequential action, optionally by typing a confirmation.

when: Before a destructive or risky action: delete, revoke, discard.

guidance.rule: Title is the question, body is the consequence, the confirm button repeats the verb.

builtIn: Role alertdialog; "Cancel" takes the first focus so Enter never destroys by accident.
youProvide: A question title and the consequence.
